title: MCP tool-calls scout record
description: One measurement the MCP tool-calls scout records per run. Two kinds: a per-category roll-up of the run's numbers, and a per-tool session-share row for the called-too-much lens.

oneOf.title: category_rollup
oneOf.description: One record per category with traffic in the window, healthy ones included, plus the project-wide baseline under category `all`. Subject is `category:<category>`.

mcp_metrics_version.description: Definition version. Charts filter on it, so bump it when a field's meaning changes.

mcp_regime.description: Which telemetry regime the numbers came from (query 0).

mcp_window_days.description: Length of the measured window in days.

mcp_category.description: Owning product category. `Uncategorized` for the no-category bucket, `all` for the project-wide baseline record.

mcp_calls.description: Calls to the category's tools in the window.

mcp_sessions.description: Distinct sessions that called the category's tools.

mcp_users.description: Distinct users that called the category's tools.

mcp_error_rate_pct.description: Errors as a percentage of calls.

mcp_struggle_session_pct.description: Percentage of the category's sessions with hammering or fail-then-retry (query 11). Null when none of the category's calls carry a session id.

mcp_p95_duration_ms.description: p95 call duration in milliseconds (query 11). Null when none of the category's calls carry a duration.

mcp_problem_tools.description: Distinct tools in the category that cleared any lens's per-tool bar this run, session share included.

mcp_share_of_project_calls_pct.description: The category's share of all $mcp_tool_call volume in the window.

mcp_report_action.description: What the scout did with this category this run.

oneOf.title: tool_session_share
oneOf.description: One record per tool per source for the top tools by session share — the called-too-much lens (query 10). Subject is `tool:<tool>:<source>`.

mcp_metrics_version.description: Definition version. Charts filter on it, so bump it when a field's meaning changes.

mcp_tool.description: Inner tool name, with the exec dispatcher unwrapped as the cookbook does.

mcp_source.description: Calling surface, for example self_driving, mcp, posthog_code, slack, posthog_ai, wizard.

mcp_category.description: The tool's owning product category, or `Uncategorized`.

mcp_sessions_with_call.description: Sessions with at least one call to this tool.

mcp_sessions_total.description: All MCP sessions for that source in the window.

mcp_session_share_pct.description: Sessions with a call as a percentage of all sessions for the source.

mcp_calls_per_session.description: Mean calls per session that used the tool.

mcp_share_pct_prior_window.description: The same share over the preceding window, for a step-change read. Null when the source had fewer than 20 sessions in the prior window.
